verdict.rationale: Durable cross-session memory is a fair question for a desktop AI assistant, but nothing in the evidence documents the assistant writing to or automatically recalling memories about the user. The document knowledge base (RAG) and system prompt variables are adjacent features, not long-term user memory, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically
